Detailed Description

Base class for robot sensors.

Derives from ComponentBase for common lifecycle (validity, actor, destroy). Each derived sensor keeps its own specialized ComputeSignal signature.

◆ GetWorldTransform()

TransformRT superdex::robotics::SensorBase::GetWorldTransform ( ) const
nodiscard

The sensor's pose in world space.

When the sensor is bound to a Mochi Actor, that actor's transform is already world-resolved by the simulation, so world = actorWorldTransform * parentFromSensor. When the sensor has no actor (a fusion sensor that consumes other sensors, or a scene sensor standing in for a scene root that has no Mochi actor), the scene root is the parent: world = parentFromSensor, i.e. the scene-root-to-world transform is treated as identity (a surrogate for a real scene-root actor) until scene spawn transforms are supported.

Returns
Sensor pose in world space.
